pages.text: Where to find one: $(l)Wyvern Nests$() (rock spires topped with a bone nest, in Ashen Wastes, Basalt Deltas, Molten Glass Lakes, Sulfur Springs and the Hellwood Jungle) are guarded by a fierce wyvern: $(l)defeat it$() and it leaves its $(item)egg$(). Hatch it: the wyvern is yours. Wild wyverns also roam and can be tamed with $(item)meat$(). $(l)One wyvern per player.$()

$(li)Right-click: ride it. $(li)Sneak + right-click: sit / follow. $(li)Meat heals it; tamed, it has $(l)160 HP$() and regenerates.$(br2)$(l)In combat$(), it takes off on its own, circles your enemy, breathes fire (it sets creatures ablaze, never blocks) and dives to bite. While you ride it, it breathes fire on what you attack.
pages.title: Compagnon

pages.text: Her attacks:$(li)$(l)Flame jet$(): a continuous stream of fire.$(li)$(l)Great fireball$() when the enemy is far: she draws in her breath, then spits a sphere of fire that bursts on impact.$(li)$(l)Wing gust$() up close: two huge wing beats blow enemies away and slow them.$(li)$(l)Tail sweep$(): a full spin that hits everything around.$(li)$(l)Dive$() to bite. None of them harm you, your pets or blocks.
pages.title: Attaques

pages.text: $(l)Impossible to lose$():$(li)it follows you through portals to other dimensions (unless it is sitting);$(li)the $(item)Wyvern Whistle$() calls all your wyverns back, from anywhere, even unloaded areas or another dimension;$(li)if it dies, its $(item)egg$() comes back to you with its name: hatch it again.
pages.title: Fidélité

pages.text: $(l)Flying$(): move forward while looking up to take off, look down to dive, release to glide slowly. If you dismount in the air, you get a few seconds of $(l)Slow Falling$().
pages.title: Vol
